name: Skardu
description: The gateway to Baltistan: cold desert, glacial lakes like Upper Kachura and Shangrila, and the high Deosai plains by jeep.
lead: Cold desert, glacial lakes and the high Deosai plains, two days north of Lahore

image.alt: Still water of Upper Kachura Lake at dawn, reflecting a sunlit rocky peak and tall poplars

overview.headline: Cold desert and glacial lakes at the end of the Indus road
paragraphs: Skardu sits in a wide bowl of the Indus, ringed by bare mountains: sand dunes on the valley floor, poplar villages along the river, and clear lakes tucked into the hills at Kachura.

It is also the way up to Deosai, one of the highest plateaus on earth, where the road crosses open grassland and wildflowers in summer. Up the Shigar valley, a restored fort marks the old route towards K2.

seasons.text: Apricot blossom in April, though Deosai is still under snow. Days 12–20°C.
Warm and dry, 25–32°C in the valley. The road over Deosai opens from late June.
Gold poplars and clear skies in October. Days 10–20°C, nights near freezing.
Very cold, down to −15°C at night. Deosai and the high roads close.
